coverage: Entire collected suite verified across resumed runs; the failed unsynchronized tick baseline was corrected and rerun. This is not a single uninterrupted full-suite pass.
ci_limit: GitHub Chromium 156 results must be evaluated separately.

ci_allocation.interpretation: These separate measurements motivate distinct build and test jobs; their sum is not a measured complete CI duration or a prediction of Chromium 156 performance.
ci_allocation.result: Build has a 20-minute job budget; integration retains 45 minutes, its priority tests, entire suite, per-test deadlines, diagnostics and assertions. The integration job checks the same-run wheel SHA-256 and fails if its build failed or was skipped.
